title: PAR-14 32-bit DWG decompressor-size admission
mode: Local source-backed implementation slice with generated unit vectors
scope: Prevent silent truncation when 64-bit DWG compressed/decompressed size arguments exceed the 32-bit cursor representation used by dwgCompressor.
Exercise both R2004/AC1018 and R2007/AC1021 decompressor entry points with bounded positive streams and oversized size declarations.
Keep fixture policy, LibreCAD compatibility, and the fast-test cadence intact.

localFinding.description: decompress18 and decompress21 accepted uint64_t lengths but implicitly narrowed them into uint32_t size/cursor state. A declaration of 2^32 + N wrapped to N and could be accepted as a valid small stream.

implementation.behavior: Both entry points reject compressed or decompressed lengths greater than UINT32_MAX before retaining the supplied pointers or reading/writing; rejected calls clear prior decoder state. Valid sizes are explicitly cast only after the bound check.
coverage: Valid AC1018 extended-copy input and output remain accepted.
Valid AC1021 literal/back-reference input and output remain accepted.
Oversized compressed-input and decompressed-output sizes are rejected for both algorithms.
Output sentinel bytes remain unchanged and decoded-byte state is cleared for all oversized declarations.
The same decompressor instance accepts a valid AC1018/AC1021 retry after refusal.

validation.broadWave1Attempt: FAIL before production fix: 64 assertions; four new decompressor-size cases and 60 unrelated object/metadata assertions. The full executable was not rerun after the fix.
validation.scopedDiffCheck: PASS (git diff --check on changed code/test/CMake/plan files; receipt whitespace scan)

limitations: This slice establishes safe rejection of unrepresentable size arguments; it does not establish general DWG decompressor correctness or parser security.
The broad wave1 executable had unrelated object/metadata assertion failures before the production fix; those assertions were not investigated or claimed fixed here.
No ODA/native/independent reader was run. No DWG reader parse body or wire-format interpretation was changed.
The shared worktree remains broadly dirty and no commit was created.
